hook: Clinical obesity carried 1.69 times the death risk, preclinical only 1.19, across 844,108 adults.
summary: Applying the 2025 Lancet Commission definitions to four cohorts in China, the UK, the USA and Spain, the authors found that adding waist measures to BMI changes who counts as obese. Clinical obesity, with organ dysfunction, was tied to much higher all-cause mortality than preclinical obesity, and most preclinical cases did not progress over 10 years. These are observational associations, not proof of cause.
title: Validation of clinical and preclinical obesity across global cohorts.
